name: Yagyuu Juubee Misago
original_name: 柳生 十兵衛 鶚
source:
The only daughter of the Yagyuu family and also its successor.
Based on Yagyuu Jubei Mitsuyoshi, who was one of the most famous and romanticized of the samurai in Japan's feudal era.
